name: Composed scenes: a scene is an object placed into a world
body: Dean (2026-11-20): a scene is an object containing a bunch of objects, and scenes can be placed into the world and stitched together. A scene is a world file; a `scene_instance` entity names it (`scene` property) and places it with its transform; the loader expands the instance's entities into the parent world with the instance's transform composed in, each instance becoming one streaming room (so room streaming is what loads and unloads scenes). Nested scenes allowed, with a depth limit. Instance entity ids are namespaced so two instances of one scene never collide.
